tankForm.unitsNote: Values in {{level}} and {{volume}} (change units in the header).
tankForm.name: Name
tankForm.capacityHint: Vertical cylinder from height and diameter, or the last point of the strapping table when there is one.
tankForm.limitsHint: Measured from the tank bottom. Order: minimum ≤ low < high ≤ overflow. Leave empty to skip a limit.
tankForm.strappingHint: Optional. Paste the gauge chart, one point per line (tab, space, ; or comma between the columns). Feet-inches like 5'6" are accepted. Without a table, volume comes from the cylinder.
tankForm.locationFailed: Could not get the location. Type the coordinates instead.
tankForm.errPositive: Enter a number greater than zero.
tankForm.errOrder: Out of order: minimum ≤ low < high ≤ overflow.
tankForm.errStrappingLine: Line {{line}} could not be read (needs a level and a volume).
tankForm.errStrappingRows: The table needs at least 2 points.
tankForm.errStrappingOrder: Point {{row}}: levels must increase and stay within the tank height; volumes never decrease.

gaugeForm.name: Name

gaugeReport.heading: Gauge report
gaugeReport.sub: Opening and closing gauges, oil and water per tank, from the continuous gauges.
gaugeReport.inProgress: This period has not ended yet. Closing gauges and production fill in once it does.
gaugeReport.error: Could not build the report. Check the connection to the server.
gaugeReport.noteNoGauge: No level gauge on this tank
gaugeReport.noteNoOpening: No reading near the opening time
gaugeReport.noteNoClosing: No reading near the closing time
gaugeReport.noteSingleFloat: Single-float gauge, no interface: liquid produced {{amount}} {{unit}}
gaugeReport.negativeHint: Negative: a drop smaller than {{inches}} in was not counted as removed, or the gauge needs a check.
gaugeReport.method: Estimated from the continuous gauges. Opening and closing: median of the readings within 10 minutes of the time. Removed: drops of more than {{inches}} in of level, such as hauls, transfers or draining. Produced = closing − opening + removed. Volumes come from each tank's strapping table, without temperature correction. Not for custody transfer: check against run and haul tickets.
